integrity: Analytic all-size proof is accompanied by reproducible exact-rational finite tests. The reported review is same-model only; no independent mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The analytic positivity classification applies only to completed three-stage RKL2 updates on uniformly weighted unweighted complete bipartite graph heat systems, not to arbitrary graphs, nonlinear problems or individual stages. Historical priority remains qualified.
title: Sharp positivity thresholds for three-stage RKL2 heat stepping on complete bipartite graphs
